_comment: Transition-outcome contract for the Market Titration layer. Versioned falsifiable definitions of 'a transition happened'. Horizons are TRADING days (bar-indexed). sigma_pre uses only pre-entry bars (leakage-safe). The primary family is ABSOLUTE because per-event direction is not available on this repository's evidence path — directional labels are computed only when a real direction exists. See docs/TITRATION_RESPONSE_CALIBRATION.md.
